name: ESPHome Dashboard
author: David Reed
description: Fleet status for your ESPHome devices in the Omarchy bar. Finds every device over mDNS (like Home Assistant does) and TCP-checks each one's API port, so the pill shows how many are online and turns urgent when one drops. The popup lists each device with platform, board, firmware version, latency, and flags any API with no Noise encryption set. No configuration needed. Optionally connect a Home Assistant token to see and install pending OTA firmware updates.

barWidget.description: How many of your ESPHome devices are online, right in the bar - accent/urgent when one drops. Popup lists every device with platform, board, firmware version, latency, and an unencrypted-API warning where it applies.

schema.label: How often to rescan and health-check (seconds, minimum 10)
Notify for which events (comma list): offline,online,new,firmware - or 'all'
Auto-dismiss notification after N seconds (0 = daemon default)
Comma-separated mDNS names to ignore (e.g. devices you don't want tracked)
Log raw CLI output to the shell log: on or off
